bounds: Five agent/channel/sender tuple identities, three grant row keys, one request generation per scope, arbitrary grant removal. Request UUID uniqueness and collision-resistant canonical grant hashing are assumptions.
limitations: Full Unicode values are represented by collision families, including legacy delimiter collisions. Random UUID bit entropy and hash collision probabilities are outside the finite state space.

SQL conflict decisions are atomic. Between the conflict and the follow-up read another transaction may remove the row, which fails explicitly. Named real SQL tests cover conflict receipts and service readback.
Only the finite identity projection is proved. Admission, expiry and approval recovery are in PairingAdmission.qnt.
